svg.title: Dapr in self-hosted mode
svg.desc: On the left, a dashed region labelled Docker Desktop holds the four containers that dapr init runs: the Dapr scheduler, which schedules jobs to run at specified intervals; the Dapr placement service, which creates a mapping table of actor instances and pods; Redis, for state management and pub/sub messaging; and Zipkin, which receives distributed tracing. In the middle, dapr run starts an application with a Dapr sidecar beside it, and the sidecar talks to each of those containers. On the right, the sidecar uses components for publish and subscribe, workflows, state management, configuration and secrets. Along the bottom, a dashed strip says this runs on a local dev machine or virtual machine, on Windows, macOS, Linux or ARM.
svg.text: Windows, macOS, Linux or ARM: a local dev machine or virtual machine
